title: Require a safe owned directory for atomic vector transactions
description: P2 security review: atomic_write_json_batch hardens lock, target, journal, and artifacts but never validates the common parent directory itself. A symlinked, non-owned, or group/world-writable directory permits concurrent path substitution around recovery and publication. Validate the exact parent as an owned non-symlink directory with no group/world write bits before taking the batch lock; add unsafe-directory tests.
